# Learned Validation Rules
<!-- Auto-generated from reviewer rejections. Do not edit manually. -->

## Rules
- Reject if the concept the question tests is not taught anywhere in this session's reading material.
- Reject if the question is about a different technology or domain than the session teaches, even if a keyword overlaps.
- Reject if the question restates another question already in the set, even in different words.
- Reject if the text is a page heading, article title or sentence fragment rather than a well-formed standalone interview question.
- Reject if the question is so broad it could be asked for any AI course and does not test a specific concept from this session.
